name: Daily Fact
description: A new little fact every day, on paper white.
author: AnythingWidgets

pool: Honey found in ancient tombs was still edible.
Octopuses have three hearts.
Bananas are berries. Strawberries are not.
A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Wombat droppings are cube-shaped.
Antarctica is the largest desert on Earth.
Crows can remember human faces.
Sharks are older than trees.
The Moon drifts about 3.8 cm farther every year.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth.
A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
Cleopatra lived nearer to us than to the first pyramids.
Butterflies taste with their feet.
A teaspoon of neutron star weighs billions of tons.
Sea otters hold hands while they sleep.
Venus spins backwards compared to most planets.
Scotland’s national animal is the unicorn.
